title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Food Systems for Food Security Malawi programme will work in Central Region and Lilongwe City, Malawi. It aims to contribute to Concern Malawi’s Food Systems for Food Security thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is for vulnerable households to experience increased levels of food and nutrition security by engaging in income generation along food value chains. The programme will support over 361,680 people living in extreme and poor households, youth, households with disabled members. This will be done through improving access to finance, improved access to business knowledge and skills, improving nutiritonal and dietary diversity in individual and households consumption and improved access to markets and private sector linkages for vulnerable farmers.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: To build resilience in food systems that prioritizes food and nutrition security for the extreme poor, while promoting sustainable management of natural resources . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: DRR 1 / Aid to the environment 1 / Capacity Building 1 / Gender Equality 1 / Nutrition 1: With the inclusion of these markers within the FS4FS programme, evidence generated should capture this and, therefore, influence policies accordingly.
